heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Why choose CodeIgniter?
items.answer: It is lightweight, fast and simple, ideal for quick delivery and small to mid-sized projects.

items.question: CodeIgniter or Laravel?
items.answer: Laravel suits larger, feature-rich projects. CodeIgniter suits lean, fast-to-market ones. We advise per project.

items.question: Can you take over my existing project?
items.answer: Yes. We review the code and continue development or maintenance.

items.question: How long does codeigniter development take?
items.answer: A business website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom web applications take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
